# F2 — Internal-URL block

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Floor (always on)
- **Applies when:** Always (every app).
- **Purpose:** Server-side code cannot be used to reach DevOS, the host, the tailnet or cloud metadata.
- **Blocks:** preview and live deploys when any check fails
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Checks

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **F2-1** Every server-side fetch goes through the template's safeFetch. Static check: no raw HTTP client (fetch, http/https.request, axios, undici, got, requests, httpx) outside safeFetch itself. | auto | `scan_report` |
| **F2-2** A 10-case test refuses loopback, RFC 1918 private ranges, link-local, CGNAT/tailnet 100.64.0.0/10, Docker ranges, 169.254.169.254, IPv6 loopback and ULA, non-HTTP(S) schemes, and an address that becomes internal after DNS resolution or a redirect. | auto | `test_report` |
